rule: Light touch only. Do not rewrite pages that already tell the story. Keep inline links, sources, and useful context; do not move them all into a bibliography. Remove skeptical boxes and harsh asides, and keep the facts those boxes carried. Add a picture only where the page already points to a place or a work and a verified reusable image exists. meets_goal means leave the writing alone. Kevin is the voice model and is not to be churned. The Longinus photograph stays.
